name: Dummy Text Generator
summary: Generate English placeholder paragraphs with control over sentences and word length — in your browser.
description: Create readable English dummy copy for layouts and mockups. Choose paragraph count, sentences per paragraph, and words per sentence. Output is deterministic (not Latin Lorem Ipsum). Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: How is this different from Lorem Ipsum?
faqs.answer: This tool generates English placeholder sentences so mockups look closer to real copy. Use the Lorem Ipsum Generator for classic Latin filler.

faqs.question: Is the text random?
faqs.answer: No. It cycles a fixed English word list, so the same settings always produce the same output.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
